reviewers.scope: Review the public 88d4 product narrative, responsive reading experience, and evidence-boundary presentation.
requiredChecks: Confirm the public 88d4 Chinese brand narrative and 26-module reading experience are coherent across mobile and desktop evidence.
Confirm public labels keep synthetic, replay, evidence, and live-action boundaries explicit without implying live Agent execution.
Confirm the CLI screenshot and five-viewport automated evidence are sufficient, and record any visual or content findings.

reviewers.scope: Review the public Amazon Ads replay, canonical Chinese domain content, and synthetic evidence boundaries.
requiredChecks: Confirm replay formulas, terms, downloads, and canonical Chinese domain output remain traceable and unchanged on the public site.
Confirm synthetic Amazon Ads evidence is clearly labeled and cannot be mistaken for real-account performance proof.
Confirm unknown, stop-condition, and no-external-action boundaries remain visible and operationally unambiguous.

reviewers.scope: Review the public browser, accessibility, Web Vitals, Lighthouse, artifact integrity, and stability evidence.
requiredChecks: Confirm G4-R5 reports 10 of 10 expected tests with zero failed, flaky, or skipped cases, including prior hydration-failure routes.
Confirm all six Lighthouse runs are present and both target medians meet the locked performance, accessibility, and best-practices thresholds.
Confirm the 12-file evidence manifest and pre/post public and remote readbacks prove the observed release stayed stable without mutation.

reviewers.scope: Review the public TLS, redirect, security-header, route-isolation, legacy-preservation, and authorization-boundary evidence.
requiredChecks: Confirm TLS, release identity, relative redirects, single-value security headers, 404, 405, and port 18921 isolation remained correct.
Confirm the a2fe runtime, old MKD site, five-container health, and renewal timer remained preserved with no runtime changes.
Confirm this evidence can support only public static acceptance and cannot authorize production live Agent, provider calls, or final acceptance.

deploymentGate.reason: Four current independent reviewers accepted the 88d4 public static evidence; G5 delayed stability and all production live capabilities remain separate.
